chartPattern.explanation: The chart shows a rounded U-shaped 'cup' formation from late November 2025 (lows around $110-$115) to late February 2026 (highs around $137-$138). Following this, the price has formed a 'handle' by consolidating and drifting slightly downward from late February 2026, with resistance around $137-$138 and current price at $133.59.
chartPattern.signal: A confirmed breakout above the resistance level of the handle, around $137-$138, could signal a continuation of the prior uptrend.

fundamentals.name: Airbnb, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Airbnb, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a platform for stays, experiences, and services worldwide. The company's marketplace connects hosts and guests online or through mobile devices to book spaces, experiences, and services. It also offers gift cards. The company was formerly known as AirBed & Breakfast, Inc. and changed its name to Airbnb, Inc. in November 2010. Airbnb, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

judgment.summary: Strong growth and profitability metrics are somewhat tempered by a high valuation and a recent earnings miss.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter missed EPS estimates; next earnings date is 2026-08-05.
positives: Revenue growth 17.9% YoY and analyst estimates for 25.2% current FY growth indicate strong top-line expansion.
Gross margin at 82.9% and Profit margin at 19.9% demonstrate excellent profitability.
Return on equity at 32.3% and Return on assets at 6.2% show efficient use of capital.
Free cash flow of $3.19B indicates robust cash generation.
Forward P/E of 22.10 is attractive relative to trailing P/E of 33.07 and PEG ratio of 1.23.
negatives: Last quarter's EPS missed estimates by 14.1%.
Price/Sales (TTM) of 6.27 and Price/Book of 10.41 suggest a high valuation.
Operating margin at 3.2% is relatively low despite high gross margins.
Quick ratio of 0.74 indicates potential short-term liquidity concerns.

news.paragraph: Airbnb's stock has seen recent gains, outperforming the market and attracting investor attention, with one report highlighting its position in Jeff Bezos's portfolio and another noting its GF Value is above the current price. While recent news focuses on positive stock performance and valuation metrics, the company's last reported quarter missed EPS estimates. The upcoming earnings report in August will be key to watch.
